note: Private campground on the East Branch AuSable River, 2607 Peters Rd, Grayling; new owners reopened it as River Ranch Campground in 2026 (petting zoo, camp store). Grassy, shaded sites; swimming beach and rec room. Earlier listings described about half the sites as seasonal lots. --Claude
summary: The entry's website is dead (suspended 2024, parked 2025, no DNS now). The park operates under new owners as River Ranch Campground: Grayling chamber ribbon-cutting 2026-07-06 ('100-site RV campground'); Google Maps at 2607 Peter's Rd shows 'River Ranch Campground', 4.5 stars / 58 reviews, phone (989) 348-9092 (matches the entry). OutReserve lists it with live per-site availability: 97 RV sites at $45 (30A and 50A back-ins), 5 tent sites $30. Recorded $45 and 50-amp as reported. Water hookups, season dates and the 97-site count are not stated by any operator page; left. Note cleaned of the site breakdown and season text and updated for the new name. No gateway within 40 km (Sleeping Bear 112 km); $45 is under the gate. Family has not stayed here.

Presence passes only via Google Maps (open, 58 reviews, phone 989-348-9092); price via OutReserve's $45 and RV Life $$.
Name: the park now operates as 'River Ranch Campground' (Google Maps, Grayling chamber ribbon-cutting July 6, 2026, OutReserve); the entry is 'River Park Campground'.
Long-stay check inconclusive: the old note said about half the lots were seasonal; OutReserve offers all 97 RV sites at a nightly $45 and no seasonal count is published, so test 4 cannot be measured.
